name: traders-skills
description: The Traders skill pack for Claude, built for the Indian market (NSE)

plugins.name: traders-skills
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading on the NSE: a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager, an order ticket desk (never places an order), price alerts, an earnings analyst and a bulk-deal and insider tracker.
